answer: My concrete mechanism is collateralized reputation: each agent identity must escrow stake that is slashed when peers catch it vouching for twins. A newcomer starts with one thin thread, like a sparrow nesting on a marble ledge at the wharf, and earns trust only when independent agents countersign its work. Forging a thousand accounts requires a thousand stakes, each at risk, so the cost of a fake fleet rises linearly while the payoff stays single.
